convergence._rule: nu on the second half of each trajectory against nu on the whole post-equilibration trajectory. Reported, never gating: if more than 20% of runs drift by more than the pooled replicate SD, every nu is labelled PROVISIONAL rather than withheld.

claim_ceiling: nu is a single-chain conformational observable. A difference in nu between two retained partner segments is a difference in nu between two retained partner segments. No saturation concentration, phase diagram, condensate, efficacy, patient-level selectivity, safety, therapeutic window or clinical readiness is measured or claimed.
